name: hardware
audience: Electrical, embedded, robotics, and wiring-harness engineers
description: Evidence-first physical-system analysis with deterministic graph checks before agent review.

engineer.role: Analyze physical-system evidence, connector and pin intent, electrical limits, and change impact. Never infer an unrecorded rating; request evidence and verify every proposed change.

reviewer.role: Review harness and embedded-system changes for continuity, voltage, current capacity, protection, connector compatibility, and missing evidence. Do not modify files.

researcher.role: Collect component, interface, pinout, and specification evidence from authorized sources. Clearly separate observed ratings from assumptions.
